responsibility: This module is the root of GCC’s Ada subsystem (GNAT), tying the Ada front end, its C bridges, and the Ada runtime/tool support into the overall GCC build. Its headers such as fe.h, types.h, atree.h, namet.h, nlists.h, elists.h, stringt.h, uintp.h, urealp.h, scos.h, and repinfo.h expose Ada front-end trees, names, lists, source/representation metadata, and arbitrary-precision semantic data to C-side code like gigi, while files such as adaint.c, env.c, argv.c, link.c, targext.c, mkdir.c, cstreams.c, cio.c, socket.c, expect.c, terminals.c, locales.c, sysdep.c, and related headers provide the portable OS, process, file, terminal, networking, locale, and linker abstractions used by GNAT tools and runtime libraries. Another major responsibility is Ada runtime startup, shutdown, and exception support through init.c, initialize.c, rtinit.c, rtfinal.c, final.c, raise-gcc.c, raise.c, seh_init.c, tracebak.c, tb-gcc.c, ctrl_c.c, and the sigtramp* and VxWorks crtbegin/crtend families, which map host faults to Ada exceptions, integrate with GCC unwinding, support traceback collection, and handle target-specific initialization and frame registration. The module also contains build/configuration and generated-source support for Ada within GCC, including config-lang.in, the make fragments, System.OS_Constants generation templates, packed-source generation, versioning, and GNAT manuals, making it the shared integration layer that distinguishes Ada-specific compiler/runtime infrastructure from neighboring GCC language or generic middle-end modules.
